Watering Cans

Watering Cans are a type of  Farming tool. They are used to water crops in the Greenhouse and create Mutations.

Usage

[edit | edit source]

Watering Cans can retain water to be used on crops in the Greenhouse. They have up to 3 abilities depending on their rarity:

  • Hydrate dispenses between 150 and 350 water per second.
  • Fill refills the Watering Can to capacity, which goes between 3k and 20k water.
  • Aquaburst allows the player to water multiple crops at one, in a 2x2 or 3x3 area.
